verification.method: scripts/verify/spain.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank 2026/2100, share, change, density, land area
Record 2023 and decline in every later year; 2007 largest yearly gain and net inflow; only falls before 2024 were 2012–2015, each with net emigration, largest 2013; positive migration 2016–2023
Natural loss every year from 2015; births 1964 vs now, deaths; fertility now and 1998 low; among the 15 lowest of countries over 5 million
Life expectancy 1950/2026/2100, third in Europe (over 5 million) after Switzerland and Italy; median age 2026/2050
2100 total and matching year (1968); second in Southern Europe; urban share; title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 71 of 71 checks match

verification.result: All figures match. Statements about Europe are limited to countries over 5 or 10 million because some microstates rank higher. No image alt text on the page (the flag and charts carry aria-labels).
